title: Design: Move Customers window looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Due on Receipt is the default for new customers instead of COD.
  • At least ten customers are on COD, among them {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-17 Alpha and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST D-17 Bravo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p2-02-move-customers-from-cod.png, ct-p2-03-some-customers-unticked.png, ct-p2-06-move-to-cod-the-0-line.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the COD row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Untick {Customer-A}.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from COD" opens (as in ct-p2-02-move-customers-from-cod.png). Top to bottom: a "Search customers" box with a magnifier; blue "Select All" and "Select None" at the left and "{n} selected" in grey at the right; a bordered scrolling list, one customer per row with a line between rows, A to Z, every box ticked; the "Move To" box reading "Due on Receipt" with the grey line "Prefilled with your default for new customers." under it; at the bottom right "Cancel" and a blue "Move {n} Customers". The ticked-box style (light blue with a blue tick in the drawn picture, solid blue with a white tick in the build picture ct-p2-06-move-to-cod-the-0-line.png), the Move To box style (outlined with a small arrow, or filled with a solid arrow) and the Cancel style: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.
  • Step 3: the box of {Customer-A} is empty, the count reads one less and the button reads "Move" with the lower number (as in ct-p2-03-some-customers-unticked.png).
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

{n} is the number of customers on COD (the Counter Sale customer is never listed or counted).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R1: “"Move Customers" in a term's row menu (Story 2: Row menu actions) opens a window titled "Move Customers from {term}".”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S4-R4: “Every listed customer starts ticked.”
  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To hint | "Prefilled with your default for new customers." | Hint under Move To while the default is selected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log details | "{name}: {rule}" (created, deactivated, reactivated, deleted); "Name: {old} → {new}" and/or "Due: {old rule} → {new rule}" (edited); "{old} → {new}" (default changed); "{n} customers from {from} to {to}", plus "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold (customers moved) | Details column text”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
